Station pole with solar panel at left, pulse ring at antenna 28.0 s, amber rings travel down a flooded bungalow street toward a small hub, caption 'Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets.'
Rings fade, dashed scale bar draws at 29.2 s, 'More than a half-mile' amber tag pins at 29.4 s, hub mast lamp begins to light at 29.8 s; same street caption.
Street scene held with scale bar, tag and lit mast lamp; caption present to 30.6 s and gone at 30.8 s.
Street at 31.0 s, hard cut at 31.2 s to open green country with fence, tan Hub building and a Station inset; rings start; caption 'In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.' appears at 31.6 s.
Large amber rings grow from the Station inset, 'Up to five miles in open country' tag fades in 32.0 s and pins 32.2 s, mast lamp glows and hub window lights by 32.6 s.
Concentric amber rings keep spreading across the sky with the tag, lit mast lamp and lit hub window held; caption still shown.
Same open-country hub with rings and five-mile tag held; caption visible to 34.6 s and gone at 34.8 s.

Open country to 35.2 s, hard cut at 35.4 s to the hub interior: seated responder in navy jacket at a desk with a Flood path map monitor; 'Illustration. Not a real hub'; caption 'At the hub, a second, larger AI maps' from 35.6 s.
'A second, larger model' tag pins above the monitor at 36.0 to 36.4 s, yellow station dots appear along the blue creek on the monitor, responder's hands move on the keyboard.
Hub desk composition held with yellow dots on the map and the model tag; small hand movement at the keyboard; same caption.
Desk shot at 38.0 s, hard cut at 38.2 s to a full-frame Flood path map; orange path spreads along the creek at 38.6 s and orange branches down streets at 38.8 s; caption 'flood paths for responders.'
Orange paths complete; 'Higher risk' legend and 'For emergency responders' tag pin at 39.4 to 39.6 s; dashed amber zone outlines draw by 39.8 s; caption still shown.
Map held with three dashed higher-risk zones and the responders tag; caption ends at 40.4 s and the map holds uncaptioned to 40.8 s.

Cut to a cork notice board over a flooded lawn; Validation accuracy card pins at 41.2 s with an empty bar, 'Reported by the university'; ring marker at the bar start 41.8 s; caption 'The university reports early chip AI validation.'
Orange tape fills the validation bar left to right behind the ring marker, bar full by 42.8 s; same caption.
Bar full, marker slides off and fades by 43.4 s, blue second pin appears at the card's top right at 43.6 s; board and flooded street held.
Card with full bar and two pins held, no development; caption disappears at 44.6 s.

Slightly closer on the card; 98.82% fades in at 45.4 s and is legible from 45.6 s; 'Initial assessments after training' tag begins to appear at 45.8 s; caption 'Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.'
'Initial assessments after training' tag swings in and settles below the validation card; 98.82% and the full bar legible; same caption.
At 47.4 s a blank 'Field result' card slides in from the right edge; at 47.8 s a yellow pushpin presses it home; same caption.
Validation card, assessments tag and blank Field result card held on the board; caption ends around 48.6 s; held without development.

Cut at 49.2 s to a green-coated figure holding a rubber stamp at the board, cards now smaller; 'Illustration. Not a real report or map'; arm lifts the stamp; caption 'The announcement reports no field result.'
Arm swings the stamp over the cards, 'None reported' stamp mark appears on the Field result card at 50.6 s, the arm then lifts again.
The arm with the stamp moves down to waist height; the figure ends with both hands low; 'None reported' stays on the card; same caption.

Cut at 52.2 s to the same figure beside a chain-link fence with skyline and pond; faint outline then a paper grid map with a blue creek pins at 52.8 s; caption 'It names no town with an installed station.'
The figure raises an arm and points across the paper map; the finger moves along the creek and then upward over the grid.
The finger points on the map; a dark 'Announcement names no installation' tag pins at the top of the map at 54.4 s, the arm returns to the side.

Fence and map held to 55.4 s; cut at 55.6 s to a wide curb scene with porch rail, flooded street, small technician holding a sheet and a case, a dashed station outline on a post, live oak and skyline; caption 'Deployment is still the goal.'
Technician holds the plan sheet in front of the torso; amber arc starts at 56.4 s, ellipse rings the dashed outline by 56.6 s; 'Field result None reported' tag pins at right; caption still shown.
'Deployment goal' amber tag pins at 57.0 s; caption shown to 57.2 s and gone by 57.4 s; from 57.6 to 57.8 s the technician lowers the sheet to an angle at waist height.

Held tableau: technician about a fifth of frame height with a tilted plan sheet at the waist, dashed station outline inside an amber ellipse, Deployment goal and Field result tags at right, no caption; sheet not seen entering the case.
Same tableau held at 59.0 and 59.2 s; at 59.4 s a dim credits card fades in, bright by 59.6 s, showing The Daily Dispatch, Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, URL, sources and music credit.
Static credits card: Texas AI Docket wordmark, flag, texasaidocket.com, sources UT San Antonio Today September 8th, illustration, map and music credit with CC BY 4.0 licence text.
Same static credits card continues unchanged across all five samples with wordmark, flag, URL, sources and music credit all legible.
The static credits card continues identically across all five samples, no motion visible.
Static credits card unchanged across all five samples at 63.0 to 63.8 s with wordmark, flag, URL and credit lines.
Static credits card held through the final frame at 64.367 s with the same wordmark, flag, URL, sources and credits; three samples on this page.
